11. The Great Inventor

ledger.why: the casting line (the roles carry it)

collection.description: A child has invented a machine of sticks, string, a coconut shell and a lot of mud that does everything.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (subject) has invented something extraordinary. It is made of three sticks, a coconut shell, two pieces of string, and an alarming amount of mud. "It's a machine," (subject.he/she) explains. "It does everything." (friend) examines it carefully. One of the sticks falls off.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: "The Everything Machine," says (subject). "But it doesn't do everything yet." (friend) asks what it does now. "Mostly falls apart," (subject) admits. "I'm working on that."

a__fx.name: Answer A
a__fx.text: (subject) pulls a string. The coconut shell flips over, the mud splashes everywhere, and a small frog leaps out of the contraption. "It makes frogs!" (subject) announces triumphantly. (friend) is fairly certain the frog was already inside, but decides not to argue.
